title: R.E.P.L
description: PyScript's REPL (Read-Evaluate-Print-Loop) provides an interactive Python environment directly in your browser. Using either Pyodide or MicroPython interpreters, you can write, execute, and see results of Python code in real-time, similar to Jupyter notebooks but without any server infrastructure.

capabilities.title: What You Can Do:
capabilities.interactiveDesc: Write and execute Python code on the fly
capabilities.multipleDesc: Choose between Pyodide (full CPython) or MicroPython (lightweight)
capabilities.editableDesc: Modify examples and see results instantly
capabilities.stdlibDesc: Use Python's built-in modules like sys, math, and more
